attributes.name: pagination_button_shape
attributes.definition: Shape of the numbered page buttons in the pagination control.

values.definition: Square or slightly rounded rectangular numbered buttons, typically bordered.
Unboxed numbers or links with no button shape.

attributes.name: pagination_active_page_style
attributes.definition: How the current page is highlighted in the pagination control.

values.definition: Current page filled with an accent/brand color such as green.
Current page filled with black or near-black.
Current page indicated by outline, underline or bold only.

attributes.name: pagination_next_prev_control
attributes.definition: Form of the next/previous/last navigation controls in pagination.

values.definition: Next/last controls styled as square bordered buttons matching the number buttons.
A pill-shaped next button distinct from the number buttons.
